segments.text: pangalagaan ang ating teritoryo at itaguyod ang ating dignidad bilang isang malayang bansa.

segments.speaker: Senator Joseph Victor "JV" G. Ejercito
segments.text: Noong nakaraang taon, katuwang natin ang mga kasamahan sa Senado at sa pangunguna ni then Finance Chair

segments.speaker: Senator Joseph Victor "JV" G. Ejercito
segments.text: at ngayon ay Senate President Sherwin Gatchalian.

segments.speaker: Senator Joseph Victor "JV" G. Ejercito
segments.text: Sinuporta natin ang paglalaan ng karagdagang pondo para sa AFP Modernization.

segments.speaker: Senator Joseph Victor "JV" G. Ejercito
segments.text: Sa ilalim ng inyong kasalukoy budget para sa 2026, umabot sa 90 billion ang pinagsamang alokasyon

segments.speaker: Senator Joseph Victor "JV" G. Ejercito
segments.text: para sa revised AFP Modernization Program, 40 billion sa program appropriations

segments.speaker: Senator Joseph Victor "JV" G. Ejercito
Senator Joseph Victor "JV" G. Ejercito
segments.text: Nais po natin malaman kung gaano nakalaki sa pondong ito ang aktual na nailabas, na obliga at nagastos

segments.speaker: Senator Joseph Victor "JV" G. Ejercito
Senator Joseph Victor "JV" G. Ejercito
segments.text: At itong progreso sa ating mga proyekto na pangmodernisasyon.

segments.speaker: Senator Joseph Victor "JV" G. Ejercito
segments.text: Alin sa mga inaasahang kagamitan at sistema ang nahihatid na at nagagamit ng ating masundalo?

segments.speaker: Senator Joseph Victor "JV" G. Ejercito
Senator Joseph Victor "JV" G. Ejercito
segments.text: At alin ang mga pangangailangan ang dapat nating unahin sa pagbabalangkas ng budget para sa fiscal year 2027?

segments.speaker: Senator Joseph Victor "JV" G. Ejercito
segments.text: As Chair of the Senate Committee on Finance, and as I have done so for many years,

segments.speaker: Senator Joseph Victor "JV" G. Ejercito
segments.text: I reaffirm our commitment to sustaining the AFP's modernization

segments.speaker: Senator Joseph Victor "JV" G. Ejercito
Senator Joseph Victor "JV" G. Ejercito
segments.text: Kapag hinahamak ang ating bandila at kinigipit ang ating mga kababayan sa sarili nating mga karagatan,

segments.speaker: Senator Joseph Victor "JV" G. Ejercito
segments.text: dapat malinaw ang ating prinsipyo at matatag ang ating tugon.

segments.speaker: Senator Joseph Victor "JV" G. Ejercito
segments.text: Sa gitna ng maraming mga hamon at kinakaharap ng ating bansa,

segments.speaker: Senator Joseph Victor "JV" G. Ejercito
segments.text: kailangan buo ang ating loob at nagkakaisang ating pagtindig na mapagtatanggol ng pambansang interes.

segments.speaker: Senator Joseph Victor "JV" G. Ejercito
segments.text: Ito ang diwa ng pambansang interes.

segments.speaker: Senator Joseph Victor "JV" G. Ejercito
segments.text: Ito ang pangakong ating binibigas sa tuwing inaawit ang lupang hinirang,

segments.speaker: Senator Joseph Victor "JV" G. Ejercito
segments.text: na sa harap ng sino mang manlulupig kailanman ay hindi tayo pasisiil.

segments.speaker: Senator Joseph Victor "JV" G. Ejercito
segments.text: I remain steadfast in my belief that defending our nation's honor and sovereignty

segments.speaker: Senator Joseph Victor "JV" G. Ejercito
segments.text: through the attainment of a credible defense posture must transcend partisan loyalties,

segments.speaker: Senator Joseph Victor "JV" G. Ejercito
Senator Joseph Victor "JV" G. Ejercito
segments.text: The defense of our nation must always rise above politics

segments.speaker: Senator Joseph Victor "JV" G. Ejercito
segments.text: and remain firmly anchored in our shared commitment

segments.speaker: Senator Joseph Victor "JV" G. Ejercito
segments.text: to national security, sovereignty, and the Filipino people.

segments.speaker: Senator Joseph Victor "JV" G. Ejercito
Senator Joseph Victor "JV" G. Ejercito
segments.text: At this juncture, also, the Chair would like to acknowledge the presence of our Senate President,

segments.speaker: Senator Joseph Victor "JV" G. Ejercito
Senator Joseph Victor "JV" G. Ejercito
segments.text: So I'd like to ask my colleagues if they have any opening statement.

segments.speaker: Senator Joseph Victor "JV" G. Ejercito
segments.text: Let me start with our Senate President.

segments.speaker: Senator Sherwin "Win" T. Gatchalian
Senator Sherwin "Win" T. Gatchalian
segments.text: Magandang hapon, Secretary Teodoro, sa lahat po ng ating kasama sa Armed Forces of the Philippines.

segments.speaker: Senator Sherwin "Win" T. Gatchalian
Senator Sherwin "Win" T. Gatchalian
segments.text: Pabago ang geopolitical situation dito sa ating region at sa buong mundo na rin.

segments.speaker: Senator Sherwin "Win" T. Gatchalian
segments.text: Nakikita po natin yung iba't ibang mga conflict na nangyari sa Middle East,

segments.speaker: Senator Sherwin "Win" T. Gatchalian
segments.text: sa Eastern Europe, at sa iba pang parte ng buong mundo.

segments.speaker: Senator Sherwin "Win" T. Gatchalian
segments.text: At sa ganitong punto, importante po na maging handa tayo

segments.speaker: Senator Sherwin "Win" T. Gatchalian
segments.text: at patuloy po natin minomodernize at pinapalakas po ang ating Armed Forces.

segments.speaker: Senator Sherwin "Win" T. Gatchalian
segments.text: Kasama na rin po dito yung pagdating po sa cyber warfare.

segments.speaker: Senator Sherwin "Win" T. Gatchalian
segments.text: Marami rin po akong pabalitaan at napapanood po sa balita

segments.speaker: Senator Sherwin "Win" T. Gatchalian
segments.text: na ang cyber warfare ay isa po sa mga bagay na nagiging realidad na sa mga ganito pong sitwasyon.

segments.speaker: Senator Sherwin "Win" T. Gatchalian
segments.text: Alam ko, komplikado po itong cyberspace pero ganun pa man,

segments.speaker: Senator Sherwin "Win" T. Gatchalian
segments.text: importante na nakakabili [unclear] po tayo ng mga

segments.speaker: Senator Sherwin "Win" T. Gatchalian
segments.text: kagamitan na makakatulong po tayo sa pagprepara sa mga ganitong conflicts at warfare.

segments.speaker: Senator Sherwin "Win" T. Gatchalian
segments.text: At sa kabilang punto, ang Armed Forces of the Philippines ay hindi lang tag-defend ng ating bansa

segments.speaker: Senator Sherwin "Win" T. Gatchalian
segments.text: kung hindi rin rin meresponder ito sa mga kalamidad na nangyayari po sa ating bansa.

segments.speaker: Senator Sherwin "Win" T. Gatchalian
segments.text: At isa rin po sa mga bagay na dapat po natin tignan,

segments.speaker: Senator Sherwin "Win" T. Gatchalian
segments.text: multi-role capability ng ating armed forces, lalo na pag tumatama sa ating malaking bagyo

segments.speaker: Senator Sherwin "Win" T. Gatchalian
segments.text: o mayroong mga malalaking kalamidad na nararanasan natin.

segments.speaker: Senator Sherwin "Win" T. Gatchalian
segments.text: So kami po ay sumusuporta sa pagbibigay ng dagdag kapasidad ng ating armed forces

segments.speaker: Senator Sherwin "Win" T. Gatchalian
segments.text: at importante rin po na tuloy-tuloy yung supporta, sustainable yung pagsusuporta natin

segments.speaker: Senator Sherwin "Win" T. Gatchalian
segments.text: hanggat umabot tayo sa kakayahan na gusto natin makita.

segments.speaker: Senator Sherwin "Win" T. Gatchalian
Senator Joseph Victor "JV" G. Ejercito
segments.text: Thank you, our Senate President. Maraming salamat din sa supporta mo nung isang taon sa ating armed forces.

segments.speaker: Senator Joseph Victor "JV" G. Ejercito
segments.text: The biggest ever, probably, budget for the AFP modernization.

segments.speaker: Senator Joseph Victor "JV" G. Ejercito
Senator Panfilo "Ping" M. Lacson
segments.text: None from this representation. I'll just listen to the presentation and seek clarification if I need to. Thank you.

segments.speaker: Senator Joseph Victor "JV" G. Ejercito
segments.text: Thank you, Senator Lacson, Senator Tulfo.

segments.speaker: Senator Erwin T. Tulfo
segments.text: Thank you, Mr. Chair. Magandang araw po sa ating lahat.

segments.speaker: Senator Erwin T. Tulfo
segments.text: Today, as we deliberate the proposed 2027 budget of the Department of National Defense,

segments.speaker: Senator Erwin T. Tulfo
segments.text: let us be guided by our commitment to protect our sovereignty, uphold our territorial integrity,

segments.speaker: Senator Erwin T. Tulfo
segments.text: and ensure the safety and security of every Filipinos.

segments.speaker: Senator Erwin T. Tulfo
segments.text: But how can we do that if the budget of the National Defense is cut down,

segments.speaker: Senator Erwin T. Tulfo
Senator Erwin T. Tulfo
segments.text: Bapano po natin mapoprotektahan ang ating soberenya,

segments.speaker: Senator Erwin T. Tulfo
Senator Erwin T. Tulfo
segments.text: at masiguro ang siguridad at kapakanan ng bawat Pilipino kung binawasan po ng budget?

segments.speaker: Senator Erwin T. Tulfo
segments.text: Ang budget na ito ay hindi lamang tungkol sa numbers and allocations.

segments.speaker: Senator Erwin T. Tulfo
segments.text: It represents our investment in stronger, more capable, and more modern armed forces of the Philippines.

segments.speaker: Senator Erwin T. Tulfo
segments.text: Ang bawat pisong inilalaan sa pambansang depensa ay dapat,

segments.speaker: Senator Erwin T. Tulfo
segments.text: magsilbi sa kapakanan ng sambayan ng Pilipino.

segments.speaker: Senator Erwin T. Tulfo
segments.text: Every allocation must translate into tangible improvements in our country's defense, posture,

segments.speaker: Senator Erwin T. Tulfo
segments.text: operational readiness, and ability to respond to both traditional emerging security challenges.

segments.speaker: Senator Erwin T. Tulfo
segments.text: Nabawasan nga po ang external threat.

segments.speaker: Senator Erwin T. Tulfo
segments.text: Ang ating internal threat, tumaas naman po ang external threat, meaning kalaban galing sa labas.

segments.speaker: Senator Erwin T. Tulfo
segments.text: How do we address that kung mas maliit po na budget?

segments.speaker: Senator Erwin T. Tulfo
segments.text: We also recognize that national defense goes beyond preparedness.

segments.speaker: Senator Erwin T. Tulfo
segments.text: It encompasses our commitment to our soldiers and their families,

segments.speaker: Senator Erwin T. Tulfo
segments.text: our support for communities affected by conflict and disasters,

segments.speaker: Senator Erwin T. Tulfo
segments.text: and our contribution to a peaceful, secure, and resilient Philippines.

segments.speaker: Senator Erwin T. Tulfo
segments.text: We look forward to a constructive discussion of DND's 2027 proposed budget

segments.speaker: Senator Erwin T. Tulfo
segments.text: to ensure that every peso strategically allocated, responsibly spent,

segments.speaker: Senator Erwin T. Tulfo
segments.text: and aligned with our national defense priorities.

segments.speaker: Senator Erwin T. Tulfo
Senator Joseph Victor "JV" G. Ejercito
Senator Joseph Victor "JV" G. Ejercito
segments.text: Before we ask the Department of National Defense and the AFP for the presentation,

segments.speaker: Senator Joseph Victor "JV" G. Ejercito
segments.text: I seek the indulgence of our colleagues to allow the department and the touch agency

segments.speaker: Senator Joseph Victor "JV" G. Ejercito
segments.text: to conclude their presentation before asking questions.

segments.speaker: Senator Joseph Victor "JV" G. Ejercito
segments.text: Each center will be allowed later with about 10 minutes for questions.

segments.speaker: Senator Joseph Victor "JV" G. Ejercito
segments.text: In keeping tradition, of course, we will give priority to the officials of the Senate,

segments.speaker: Senator Joseph Victor "JV" G. Ejercito
Senator Joseph Victor "JV" G. Ejercito
segments.text: In the order of the arrival.

segments.speaker: Senator Joseph Victor "JV" G. Ejercito
segments.text: So at this point, at this juncture, I would like now to call to our Secretary of National Defense,

segments.speaker: Senator Joseph Victor "JV" G. Ejercito
segments.text: Gilbert Teodoro, Jr., to deliver his opening statement and the presentation of the department

segments.speaker: Senator Joseph Victor "JV" G. Ejercito
Senator Joseph Victor "JV" G. Ejercito
Senator Joseph Victor "JV" G. Ejercito
segments.text: Secretary Teodoro, you now have the floor.

segments.speaker: DND Secretary Gilberto C. Teodoro Jr.
segments.text: Thank you very much, Mr. Chairperson, and to our Senate President and our sponsor last year,

segments.speaker: DND Secretary Gilberto C. Teodoro Jr.
segments.text: to our Senator Lacson, Vice Chairman, and Senator Tulfo, Vice Chairman, likewise.

segments.speaker: DND Secretary Gilberto C. Teodoro Jr.
segments.text: It is indeed an honor to present our budget request once again to this honorable chamber.

segments.speaker: DND Secretary Gilberto C. Teodoro Jr.
segments.text: And might I just give a short preface and then if with the indulgence of the senators,

segments.speaker: DND Secretary Gilberto C. Teodoro Jr.
segments.text: go straight to page 15 of the presentation, which is the highlights of the proposed budget per NET.

segments.speaker: DND Secretary Gilberto C. Teodoro Jr.
segments.text: Firstly, we, the Armed Forces of the Philippines, at the forefront together with the Department of National Defense in cooperation with other agencies, have been at the forefront of external defense operations in order to deter further aggression in the West Philippine Sea and other areas now not traditionally encompassed.

segments.speaker: DND Secretary Gilberto C. Teodoro Jr.
segments.text: Secondly, there still is robust presence to preserve the gains of internal security

segments.speaker: DND Secretary Gilberto C. Teodoro Jr.
segments.text: in areas which have been cleared of the CPP, NPA, and DF threat.

segments.speaker: DND Secretary Gilberto C. Teodoro Jr.
segments.text: Nonetheless, we estimate that robust presence of the Armed Forces of the Philippines,

segments.speaker: DND Secretary Gilberto C. Teodoro Jr.
segments.text: considering that the coverage of the Armed Forces of the Philippines,

segments.speaker: DND Secretary Gilberto C. Teodoro Jr.
segments.text: not only for operational purposes, but also for administrative and logistical purposes,

segments.speaker: DND Secretary Gilberto C. Teodoro Jr.
segments.text: is not as robust within the 7,600 islands as we want.

segments.speaker: DND Secretary Gilberto C. Teodoro Jr.
segments.text: For this reason, the Philippine Army has been tasked to scope its areas of operations

segments.speaker: DND Secretary Gilberto C. Teodoro Jr.
segments.text: and also to determine for logistical and staging purposes

segments.speaker: DND Secretary Gilberto C. Teodoro Jr.
segments.text: and support purposes for our military.

segments.speaker: DND Secretary Gilberto C. Teodoro Jr.
segments.text: For our strategic basing, which we have proposed,

segments.speaker: DND Secretary Gilberto C. Teodoro Jr.
segments.text: it is necessary to establish new presence, whether these be brigades or divisions.

segments.speaker: DND Secretary Gilberto C. Teodoro Jr.
segments.text: Secondly, these areas will serve as nodes for our critical infrastructure,

segments.speaker: DND Secretary Gilberto C. Teodoro Jr.
segments.text: which has to be, as we determined, stand-alone.

segments.speaker: DND Secretary Gilberto C. Teodoro Jr.
segments.text: You mentioned earlier our cyber systems.

segments.speaker: DND Secretary Gilberto C. Teodoro Jr.
DND Secretary Gilberto C. Teodoro Jr.
segments.text: However, these rely on the, shall we say,

segments.speaker: DND Secretary Gilberto C. Teodoro Jr.
segments.text: sterile nature of critical basic infrastructure,

segments.speaker: DND Secretary Gilberto C. Teodoro Jr.
segments.text: which we have had to remediate and deal with.

segments.speaker: DND Secretary Gilberto C. Teodoro Jr.
segments.text: As you know, in terms of IT, you start with IT and then you progress to cyber

segments.speaker: DND Secretary Gilberto C. Teodoro Jr.
DND Secretary Gilberto C. Teodoro Jr.
segments.text: the basis of your resilience and stability.

segments.speaker: DND Secretary Gilberto C. Teodoro Jr.
segments.text: And one compromise in any area can lead to systemic compromises in others.

segments.speaker: DND Secretary Gilberto C. Teodoro Jr.
segments.text: This we had to continue to remediate.

segments.speaker: DND Secretary Gilberto C. Teodoro Jr.
segments.text: And as we construct our new infrastructure,

segments.speaker: DND Secretary Gilberto C. Teodoro Jr.
segments.text: we will incorporate the resilience necessary in these areas.

segments.speaker: DND Secretary Gilberto C. Teodoro Jr.
DND Secretary Gilberto C. Teodoro Jr.
segments.text: the major thrust once again is not only for the new platforms

segments.speaker: DND Secretary Gilberto C. Teodoro Jr.
segments.text: to complement with the Coast Guard our presence in the 360-degree area,

segments.speaker: DND Secretary Gilberto C. Teodoro Jr.
segments.text: but we have a big gap which we are starting to fill hopefully by the end of this year

segments.speaker: DND Secretary Gilberto C. Teodoro Jr.
segments.text: in our dockyards and our berthing facilities.

segments.speaker: DND Secretary Gilberto C. Teodoro Jr.
DND Secretary Gilberto C. Teodoro Jr.
DND Secretary Gilberto C. Teodoro Jr.
DND Secretary Gilberto C. Teodoro Jr.
DND Secretary Gilberto C. Teodoro Jr.
segments.text: are not deep nor big enough

segments.speaker: DND Secretary Gilberto C. Teodoro Jr.
segments.text: to support the type of operations that we will need.

segments.speaker: DND Secretary Gilberto C. Teodoro Jr.
segments.text: Thirdly, our Philippine Air Force continues.

segments.speaker: DND Secretary Gilberto C. Teodoro Jr.
segments.text: It's the sustainment of the systems already ordered

segments.speaker: DND Secretary Gilberto C. Teodoro Jr.
segments.text: and the upgrade of those systems.

segments.speaker: DND Secretary Gilberto C. Teodoro Jr.
segments.text: Because we have to upgrade these systems while we try to segue,

segments.speaker: DND Secretary Gilberto C. Teodoro Jr.
DND Secretary Gilberto C. Teodoro Jr.
segments.text: to complement this with platforms that we can afford in the meantime,

segments.speaker: DND Secretary Gilberto C. Teodoro Jr.
segments.text: which provide a sufficient deterrence for us.

segments.speaker: DND Secretary Gilberto C. Teodoro Jr.
DND Secretary Gilberto C. Teodoro Jr.
segments.text: We have a new commandant here, Brigadier General Apostol, who was tasked to scope the areas which need marine operations,

segments.speaker: DND Secretary Gilberto C. Teodoro Jr.

segments.speaker: DND Secretary Gilberto C. Teodoro Jr.
segments.text: Secondly, the Air Force or the Navy or them must ensure their mobility and must ensure their firepower.

segments.text: Because a fixed marine unit is not a marine unit.

segments.speaker: DND Secretary Gilberto C. Teodoro Jr.
segments.text: Its essence is its deployability and mobility.

segments.speaker: DND Secretary Gilberto C. Teodoro Jr.
segments.text: So, Brigadier General Apostol, once he is confirmed, Your Honors, hopefully soon,

segments.speaker: DND Secretary Gilberto C. Teodoro Jr.
segments.text: We have talked about the internal security dimension,

segments.speaker: DND Secretary Gilberto C. Teodoro Jr.
segments.text: but a lot of operations right now have seen the connection between territorial...

segments.speaker: DND Secretary Gilberto C. Teodoro Jr.
segments.text: defense and internal security. That is in the front of illegal, FIMI and other illegal activities by undesirable state adversaries that have been proliferating, as the Senate President knows, in our space.

segments.speaker: DND Secretary Gilberto C. Teodoro Jr.
segments.text: Which serve to weaken economic resilience, connectivity, and basic infrastructure, and perhaps other forms of malign activity, which we continued in coordination with other, with the law enforcement agencies to disrupt and to discuss.

segments.speaker: DND Secretary Gilberto C. Teodoro Jr.
segments.text: I think that is a major issue right now on internal security of which we devote a lot of cooperative time with the lead agencies, namely the PAO, the NBI.

segments.speaker: DND Secretary Gilberto C. Teodoro Jr.
segments.text: In HADR, of course, it is a constant threat.

segments.speaker: DND Secretary Gilberto C. Teodoro Jr.
segments.text: However, we have refined our deliverables now.

segments.speaker: DND Secretary Gilberto C. Teodoro Jr.
segments.text: To a coordinated response as quick as possible.

segments.speaker: DND Secretary Gilberto C. Teodoro Jr.

segments.text: What suffers here is the amount of rest and retraining time that our men and women have.

segments.speaker: DND Secretary Gilberto C. Teodoro Jr.
segments.text: Right now, we do not have enough forces, both on the operational side to have adequate R&R for them.

segments.speaker: DND Secretary Gilberto C. Teodoro Jr.
segments.text: And secondly, we lack personnel on the support side.

segments.speaker: DND Secretary Gilberto C. Teodoro Jr.
segments.text: The ratio of operating to support personnel is 80-20, more or less, which is unsustainable

segments.speaker: DND Secretary Gilberto C. Teodoro Jr.
segments.text: because logistics, intelligence, planning, we need a robust infrastructure in order to sustain the operations.

segments.speaker: DND Secretary Gilberto C. Teodoro Jr.
segments.text: So, the MOOE increase is much, much welcome, particularly, Your Honor, with the cost of fuel right now.

segments.speaker: DND Secretary Gilberto C. Teodoro Jr.

segments.speaker: DND Secretary Gilberto C. Teodoro Jr.

DND Secretary Gilberto C. Teodoro Jr.
segments.text: With capital outlay, this is where our biggest gap is.

segments.speaker: DND Secretary Gilberto C. Teodoro Jr.
segments.text: We need a lot of infrastructure right now, particularly, Your Honors, on the eastern seaboard,

segments.speaker: DND Secretary Gilberto C. Teodoro Jr.
segments.text: where we do not have naval presence.

segments.speaker: DND Secretary Gilberto C. Teodoro Jr.

segments.speaker: DND Secretary Gilberto C. Teodoro Jr.
segments.text: And with the size of Mindoro, Your Honor, that is not sufficient.

segments.speaker: DND Secretary Gilberto C. Teodoro Jr.

segments.speaker: DND Secretary Gilberto C. Teodoro Jr.
segments.text: So, we really need to refocus our strategic positioning in these areas, Your Honor.

segments.speaker: DND Secretary Gilberto C. Teodoro Jr.
segments.text: And we cannot do that until...

segments.speaker: DND Secretary Gilberto C. Teodoro Jr.
segments.text: sustainably, until the army solidifies its footprint in the Philippines.

segments.speaker: DND Secretary Gilberto C. Teodoro Jr.
segments.text: So, capital outlay, Your Honor, is extremely important.

segments.speaker: DND Secretary Gilberto C. Teodoro Jr.
segments.text: Also, for building critical infrastructure facilities for security of our platforms and security of our operations.

segments.speaker: DND Secretary Gilberto C. Teodoro Jr.
segments.text: I believe the capital outlay gap has been one of the major gaps that we have found out right now we have to catch up badly with.

segments.speaker: DND Secretary Gilberto C. Teodoro Jr.
segments.text: And it includes also access to our bases.

segments.speaker: DND Secretary Gilberto C. Teodoro Jr.
segments.text: In terms of the durability of the infrastructure.

segments.speaker: DND Secretary Gilberto C. Teodoro Jr.
segments.text: For example, the roads and bridges that will link our bases.

segments.speaker: DND Secretary Gilberto C. Teodoro Jr.
segments.text: We have found that normal roads and bridges will not be able to support some of the platforms that we have currently because of the weight.

segments.speaker: DND Secretary Gilberto C. Teodoro Jr.
segments.text: So, our mobility is a sacrifice.

segments.speaker: DND Secretary Gilberto C. Teodoro Jr.
segments.text: We cannot really bridge the whole of the Philippines.

segments.speaker: DND Secretary Gilberto C. Teodoro Jr.
DND Secretary Gilberto C. Teodoro Jr.
segments.text: So, the best that we can do is to provide hubs, as many hubs as possible, which will support sustained operations.

segments.speaker: DND Secretary Gilberto C. Teodoro Jr.
segments.text: Secondly, Your Honor, just like any other entity in the world right now, it's not a matter of just in time, but a matter of reserves and stores.

segments.speaker: DND Secretary Gilberto C. Teodoro Jr.
segments.text: And that we are busy building up our reserve and stores.
